hotel.name: The Royal Livingstone Hotel Victoria Falls Zambia by Anantara

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on the banks of the Zambezi River with direct access to Victoria Falls, a five-minute walk away.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Royal Livingstone Hotel by Anantara is located on the banks of the Zambezi river with a 5-minute walk direct access to Victoria Falls.

verified_facts.text: Zebras and other wildlife roam the hotel grounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wake up to the sight of zebras wandering the Livingstone hotel grounds.

verified_facts.text: Zambezi River and savannah views stretch from every veranda.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sweeping Zambezi River and savannah views stretch from every veranda as you relax in elegance.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is designed in a safari style.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bask in graceful safari style only steps from one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World.

verified_facts.text: Rooms combine modern convenience with explorer-era charm and have private outdoor spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in modern convenience enhanced with explorer era charm. With elegant design and private outdoor spaces, soak up nature’s wonder.

verified_facts.text: Suites evoke Victorian-era grace and have private verandas with views of the Zambezi River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Evoking Victorian era grace, spacious suites offer plenty of space to relax in. Laze on your private veranda offering impressive vistas of the Zambezi River.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites come with butler service.
Spa therapies are offered under the shade of monkey trees on the banks of the river.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrender to relaxation with spa therapies under the shade of monkey trees on the banks of the river.

verified_facts.text: Guests can toast the sunset with views of the waterfall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Raise a glass at sunset to the marvellous waterfall thundering to its depths as you recline in style.

verified_facts.text: Experiences include river safaris and helicopter waterfall excursions.
Nearby activities include Livingstone Island and Devil's Pool, a game drive, and a rhino walk.
verified_facts.excerpt:
2. Livingstone Island & Devil's Pool
3. Game Drive
4. Rhino Walk and Lion Research Safari

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers dining under the monkey tree.
The hotel has an on-site gym and a running trail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, The Royal Livingstone Hotel by Anantara has an on-site gym and running trail.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is about 14 minutes by road from Livingstone city centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Royal Livingstone Hotel by Anantara 14 minutes (10,4 km) via M10 and Mosi-Oa-Tunya/T1 to Livingstone City centre.

verified_facts.text: A Mukuni Boma dinner experience is offered.
